content.title: F-35 LIGHTNING II® (Variant C) - Stealth Multirole Fighter
content.text: About the F-35 LIGHTNING II® (Variant C) - Stealth Multirole Fighter: The U.S. Navy’s first stealth fighter, the F-35® (Variant C) is the only 5th generation, long range stealth strike fighter in the world. Designed for aircraft carrier operations, the F-35® (Variant C) has a larger wing surface area than other variants and powerfully built landing gear, making it ideal for catapult launches and fly-in arrestments. Specifications: Empty weight: 34,581 lb (15,686 kg)Range: 1,200 nmi (2,200 km)Speed: Mach 1.6Combat radius on internal fuel: 670 nmi (1.241 km) Additional information about this Brickmania® custom building kit: This officially licensed build features folding wing tips, an opening missile bay with missiles, movable flaps and elevators, and a retractable arrestor hook. Also included is a custom F-35® Pilot minifig, a detailed cockpit, printed elements, and retractable landing gear, and a custom sticker sheet. Model Statistics: Designed by Cody Osell1126 LEGO® elementsX1 custom printed minifig designed by Landon ReimerFull-color printed building instructions1/35th scale to match other Brickmania kitsAdvanced Skill Level (6-8 years building experience recommended) LOCKHEED MARTIN®, F-35 LIGHTNING II®, associated emblems and logos, and body designs of vehicles are either registered trademarks or trademarks of Lockheed Martin Corporation in the USA and/or other jurisdictions, used under license by Brickmania, LLC. All Brickmania model kits are made of new-condition LEGO bricks. This model comes disassembled and includes complete printed building instructions and comes packaged in a sealed box. This is a limited-edition kit and production may be discontinued at any time.
